digest.component_or_area: plan review gate criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability)
propositions: Four agent criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7,900 agentic runs due to missing deterministic pre-filters that skip inapplicable plans before LLM routing.

A deterministic pre-filter gate using four audit-verified trigger regexes (text conjunction, file_impact glob patterns, file_impact reason regex) must fire only when criterion vocabulary is present, skipping total-absence cases while preserving unchanged LLM routing for fired plans.

Gate skip records must be surfaced in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar under coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id, capturing every skip in a single pass at the assemble step to avoid duplicate coverage entries.

The T13 and T14 overlay criteria and removal-rationale/asserted-capability leaf criteria require separate rule tables (_DET_OVERLAY_RULES and _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES) with a unified DetGateRule schema supporting text_all conjunction, file_impact_globs matching, and file_impact_reason_re matching.

asserted-capability fires only when both module-ref and capability-verb text_all legs match (conjunction); T14 and removal-rationale additionally support file_impact-only firing independent of plan text.
The four existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 overlay rules must migrate from plain regex strings to DetGateRule objects while preserving identical fire/no-fire behavior on representative texts.
